require 'json'
request = JSON.parse(STDIN.read)
File.write(File.join(__dir__, 'request.json'), JSON.generate({argv: ARGV, request: request}))
content = File.binread(File.join(__dir__, 'response.json'))
if content == 'hang'
  File.write(File.join(__dir__, 'pid'), Process.pid)
  sleep 60
end
abort 'private-error-do-not-retain' if content == 'failure'
STDOUT.write(content)
